tasks.target_specification: Plural sat and singular stood; two inherited locative on+dative phrases.

tasks.prompt: Translate using etan: I did not eat the food; you (singular) ate it.
tasks.target_specification: Different first/second singular preterite cells; ne before finite; accusative masculine hine refers to masculine męte despite English it.

tasks.prompt: Translate using geswīcan: You (plural) cease from your work.
tasks.target_specification: Genitive work governed by geswīcan; agreeing plural-possessor adjective in genitive neuter singular.
